verdict.rationale: x402 has agents sign individual payments from an agent wallet rather than handing over a raw card number. The upto scheme authorizes a maximum and settles only what was used, batch settlement uses explicitly escrowed funds with cryptographically signed limits, and live listings carry a per-payment maxTimeoutSeconds. These provide per-transaction amount bounds and timeouts. They are not a user-issued scoped credential, and nothing documents user-set spend caps, credential expiry, or merchant allowlists on the agentic wallet. Missing for 10: user-configurable spending limits on agent wallets/credentials, credential-level expiry, merchant restrictions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scoped-credential behavior.
